risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (240+) indicates extreme market stress, FOMC event just concluded (-2 days), and earnings in 48 days add binary event risk—highly unfavourable environment for IT sector positioning.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term structure (50/200 EMA bullish, Supertrend, Ichimoku above cloud) combined with oversold stochastic cross-up and fear-zone contrarian setup offers potential mean-reversion bounce from support.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, FOMC just concluded), bearish short-term technicals (price below EMA-9/21, MACD negative, no strategy triggers), zero fundamental conviction, and earnings binary event in 48 days create unacceptable risk/reward for swing entry.
